item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 13/Feb/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A cold front will reach the coast of Guangdong tonight. It will become appreciably cooler over the region tomorrow. Under the influence of the associated dry northeast monsoon, it will be mainly fine and windier over the coast of southern China in the following couple of days. The monsoon is expected to moderate slightly over the weekend.

Date/Month: 14/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5.
Weather: Becoming appreciably cooler. Mainly cloudy. Misty with one or two rain patches at first.
Temp range: 15 - 20 C
R.H. range: 65 - 95 per Cent
PSR: Low
